title: JC said Navy running Majestic 12 was right

tellings.quote: things he said we got right is we had the the guy running Majestic 12 be from the Navy.

plain: Around 1996 in Los Angeles, the television writer Bryce Zabel says a source he calls JC told him that his show had got some things right, including making the head of Majestic 12, a rumoured secret group said to manage the UFO question, a Navy man. Zabel tells it from his own meeting with JC. If true, it would mean the real group, or something like it, was run out of the Navy.
